# D2R Mobile dependency snapshot

Copied from the user's local reference checkout on 2026-10-15. The `dm/` source tree keeps its original layout so CPU rewriting, verification, host loading, texture layout and shader tooling can resolve their internal dependencies.

Original license: [LICENSE](LICENSE). Bundled third-party licenses remain within `dm/third_party/` and their source directories.

Wonder-specific implementation lives in the project root's `runtime/`, `tools/`, `tests/`, and `ios-probe/`. Active builds use this local snapshot, not the adjacent reference checkout.
